findings.trigger: Pre-existing public-bb makes exclusive xb creation throw.
findings.effect: Finally unconditionally unlinks the pre-existing file even though this invocation never acquired ownership.
findings.repair: Track successful exclusive creation, remove only invocation-owned binary; preserve collision file and add offline collision regression.

findings.trigger: Preflight detects pre-existing same-name container before create_attempted.
findings.effect: Finally records containerAbsent=true from not create_attempted despite a known existing object. Overall passed remains false, but cleanup fact is false.
findings.repair: Separate known absence/unknown from creation attempt; report true only for verified absence, never remove a foreign pre-existing container.

positiveChecks: Exact preparation and helper hashes matched; native public binary and immutable pull receipt hashes match.
Fixed image/name, no implicit pull/network, readonly root, limited container resources, only one create intent with fsync and no retry.
Seven bounded docker cp tar reads, single regular file and expected hashes before native start.
Mounted exact public binary --version only, expected rc6 string, no node or credential/config mounts.
Timed command output limits, actual exit/OOM/state checks and owned-ID cleanup/readback; engine errors are not treated as absence.
limitations: This does not qualify Linux proving, node services, deployed adapter or general rc3 readiness.
Outer kill may prevent Docker cleanup; packet correctly retains parent reconciliation requirement and cannot claim success.
execution: Read-only source and hashes only; no Docker/native calls.
